## What changed?

Describe the user-visible change or documentation improvement and link the issue if available.

## Verification

List the affected platforms or content editions, focused checks and results. Identify anything that still needs device, editorial or maintainer verification. Use synthetic examples for evidence.

## Contributions and notices

Confirm you can submit your own changes under the terms in CONTRIBUTING.md. Identify any new or changed third-party material, its source and version, exact license or permission, required notices, and affected bundles. For a text correction, give the edition and precise reference.
